title: We’re releasing Jev 1.14.0 along with experimental features for dreamers
title_zh: 我们正在发布 Jev 1.14.0，并为梦想家们带来了实验性功能

paragraphs.en: TL;DR: We're releasing an improved Jev 1.14.0 along with experimental features for our dreamers: images, a new type, and longer context. Enter the danger zone at your own risk. 🔥
paragraphs.zh: 简而言之：我们发布了改进版 Jev 1.14.0，同时为我们的梦想家们带来实验性功能：图像、一种新类型，以及更长的上下文。 请自行承担风险进入危险区域。🔥

sents.en: TL;DR: We're releasing an improved Jev 1.14.0 along with experimental features for our dreamers: images, a new type, and longer context.
sents.zh: 简而言之：我们发布了改进版 Jev 1.14.0，同时为我们的梦想家们带来实验性功能：图像、一种新类型，以及更长的上下文。

sents.en: Enter the danger zone at your own risk. 🔥
sents.zh: 请自行承担风险进入危险区域。🔥

paragraphs.en: A huge debate we’ve been having is on the balance between reliability and creativity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们一直在进行的一场激烈争论，是关于可靠性与创造力之间的平衡。

paragraphs.en: To really care about the prod builders, we should be shipping models that meet our quality bar for intelligence and have been battle-tested to the limits of what we can do internally.
paragraphs.zh: 要真正关心生产构建者，我们应该发布的模型既要达到我们的智能质量标准，又要在内部能力极限下经过实战检验。

paragraphs.en: On the other hand, there’s no way that our team has a full understanding of what is needed to spark delight in the world and build sick sci-fi. We don’t want to impose our values of extreme reliability on those dreamers.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，我们的团队也不可能完全理解怎样才能在世界上激发喜悦、打造超酷的科幻作品。 我们不想把自己对极致可靠性的价值观强加给那些梦想家。

sents.en: On the other hand, there’s no way that our team has a full understanding of what is needed to spark delight in the world and build sick sci-fi.
sents.zh: 另一方面，我们的团队也不可能完全理解怎样才能在世界上激发喜悦、打造超酷的科幻作品。

sents.en: We don’t want to impose our values of extreme reliability on those dreamers.
sents.zh: 我们不想把自己对极致可靠性的价值观强加给那些梦想家。

paragraphs.en: Our solution: share those dreamer-ready features under “danger zone” flags in our API headers. These are features that will be here to stay for future models, are (as far as we can tell) better than what exists out there, and will continue to get better by leaps and bounds. But as a warning, we think there is still way too much jaggedness for us to vouch for these for production use cases!
paragraphs.zh: 我们的解决方案：在 API 请求头中以「危险区域」标志的形式开放这些可供梦想家使用的功能。 这些功能将在未来的模型中继续存在，（据我们所知）比现有的方案更好，并且会持续突飞猛进地改进。 但要提醒的是，我们认为目前的参差不齐程度仍然太高，我们无法为生产环境用例作保！

sents.en: Our solution: share those dreamer-ready features under “danger zone” flags in our API headers.
sents.zh: 我们的解决方案：在 API 请求头中以「危险区域」标志的形式开放这些可供梦想家使用的功能。

sents.en: These are features that will be here to stay for future models, are (as far as we can tell) better than what exists out there, and will continue to get better by leaps and bounds.
sents.zh: 这些功能将在未来的模型中继续存在，（据我们所知）比现有的方案更好，并且会持续突飞猛进地改进。

sents.en: But as a warning, we think there is still way too much jaggedness for us to vouch for these for production use cases!
sents.zh: 但要提醒的是，我们认为目前的参差不齐程度仍然太高，我们无法为生产环境用例作保！

paragraphs.en: See these new capabilities as a continuation of what we’ve built over 2 years of stealth. They’re less ready for automation, but very fun to play with. They’re also an early glimpse into what we’re focused on making reliable enough to meet TypeSafe standards.
paragraphs.zh: 把这些新能力看作我们在两年潜行开发中积累成果的延续。 它们还不太适合自动化，但玩起来非常有趣。 它们也是我们专注使其可靠到符合 TypeSafe 标准这一方向的早期预览。

sents.en: See these new capabilities as a continuation of what we’ve built over 2 years of stealth.
sents.zh: 把这些新能力看作我们在两年潜行开发中积累成果的延续。

sents.en: They’re less ready for automation, but very fun to play with.
sents.zh: 它们还不太适合自动化，但玩起来非常有趣。

sents.en: They’re also an early glimpse into what we’re focused on making reliable enough to meet TypeSafe standards.
sents.zh: 它们也是我们专注使其可靠到符合 TypeSafe 标准这一方向的早期预览。

paragraphs.en: Not only are we enabling multimodality for future Jev models, we’re enabling it for the current Jev that you all know and love. Surprise: the Jev you all know and love ( jev-1.13.0 ) was multimodal all along!
paragraphs.zh: 我们不仅在为未来的 Jev 模型启用多模态，也在为你们所熟知和喜爱的当前 Jev 启用多模态。 惊喜：你们所熟知和喜爱的 Jev（jev-1.13.0）其实一直以来就是多模态的！

sents.en: Not only are we enabling multimodality for future Jev models, we’re enabling it for the current Jev that you all know and love.
sents.zh: 我们不仅在为未来的 Jev 模型启用多模态，也在为你们所熟知和喜爱的当前 Jev 启用多模态。

sents.en: Surprise: the Jev you all know and love ( jev-1.13.0 ) was multimodal all along!
sents.zh: 惊喜：你们所熟知和喜爱的 Jev（jev-1.13.0）其实一直以来就是多模态的！

paragraphs.en: Image support is fully composable via a find-and-replace in assets . You can put them anywhere that our JSON interface supports: in the state , instructions , or even criteria ! Play around with it, push the boundaries of technology, and let us know where Jev can improve.
paragraphs.zh: 图像支持完全可以通过资源中的查找替换实现组合。 您可以将它们放在我们的 JSON 接口支持的任何位置：state（状态）、instructions（指令），甚至 criteria（标准）中！ 试用一下吧，挑战技术的边界，并告诉我们 Jev 在哪些方面可以改进。

sents.en: Image support is fully composable via a find-and-replace in assets .
sents.zh: 图像支持完全可以通过资源中的查找替换实现组合。

sents.en: You can put them anywhere that our JSON interface supports: in the state , instructions , or even criteria !
sents.zh: 您可以将它们放在我们的 JSON 接口支持的任何位置：state（状态）、instructions（指令），甚至 criteria（标准）中！

sents.en: Play around with it, push the boundaries of technology, and let us know where Jev can improve.
sents.zh: 试用一下吧，挑战技术的边界，并告诉我们 Jev 在哪些方面可以改进。

paragraphs.en: As a warning, all models (Jev included) perform worse on multimodality over pure text. Breaking down questions into the simplest possible decompositions helps a lot.
paragraphs.zh: 需要提醒的是，所有模型（包括 Jev）在多模态任务上的表现都逊于纯文本任务。 将问题拆解成尽可能简单的子问题，会大有帮助。

sents.en: As a warning, all models (Jev included) perform worse on multimodality over pure text.
sents.zh: 需要提醒的是，所有模型（包括 Jev）在多模态任务上的表现都逊于纯文本任务。

sents.en: Breaking down questions into the simplest possible decompositions helps a lot.
sents.zh: 将问题拆解成尽可能简单的子问题，会大有帮助。

paragraphs.en: Check out docs: docs.typesafe.ai/go/images
paragraphs.zh: 查看文档：docs.typesafe.ai/go/images

paragraphs.en: We’re introducing another new type as well: box . It returns a single bounding box - no type errors allowed. It’s our first type that’s not purely meant for smart-if statements, and is a preview for our explorations beyond simple decisions into what else System One Models can support.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还将引入另一个新类型：box。 它返回单个边界框——不允许出现类型错误。 这是我们第一个并非纯粹用于智能条件语句的类型，也是我们探索 System One 模型除简单决策之外还能支持什么的预览。

sents.en: We’re introducing another new type as well: box .
sents.zh: 我们还将引入另一个新类型：box。

sents.en: It returns a single bounding box - no type errors allowed.
sents.zh: 它返回单个边界框——不允许出现类型错误。

sents.en: It’s our first type that’s not purely meant for smart-if statements, and is a preview for our explorations beyond simple decisions into what else System One Models can support.
sents.zh: 这是我们第一个并非纯粹用于智能条件语句的类型，也是我们探索 System One 模型除简单决策之外还能支持什么的预览。

paragraphs.en: We made huge leaps and bounds on this one recently, so we’re enabling this only for jev-1.14.0 (spoilers).
paragraphs.zh: 我们最近在这一方面取得了巨大的飞跃和进展，因此我们仅针对 jev-1.14.0（剧透预警）启用此功能。

paragraphs.en: We’ve heard you loud and clear on context lengths. Jev actually supports a much longer context length than we’ve enabled in production. We chose to limit it intentionally because Jev, like all models, is less reliable on longer contexts, and this constraint encourages more effective usage patterns in prod.
paragraphs.zh: 关于上下文长度，我们已经清楚地听到了你们的反馈。 实际上，Jev 支持的上下文长度比我们在生产环境中启用的要长得多。 我们选择有意加以限制，因为 Jev 和所有模型一样，在较长上下文上的可靠性较低，而这一约束能促使在生产环境中形成更有效的使用模式。

sents.en: We’ve heard you loud and clear on context lengths.
sents.zh: 关于上下文长度，我们已经清楚地听到了你们的反馈。

sents.en: Jev actually supports a much longer context length than we’ve enabled in production.
sents.zh: 实际上，Jev 支持的上下文长度比我们在生产环境中启用的要长得多。

sents.en: We chose to limit it intentionally because Jev, like all models, is less reliable on longer contexts, and this constraint encourages more effective usage patterns in prod.
sents.zh: 我们选择有意加以限制，因为 Jev 和所有模型一样，在较长上下文上的可靠性较低，而这一约束能促使在生产环境中形成更有效的使用模式。

paragraphs.en: We aren’t your parents though, so while we strongly recommend limiting context length, you no longer have to:
paragraphs.zh: 不过我们不是你的父母，所以虽然我们强烈建议限制上下文长度，但你不再必须这样做：

paragraphs.en: Check out docs: docs.typesafe.ai/models#context-length
paragraphs.zh: 查看文档：docs.typesafe.ai/models#context-length

paragraphs.en: We love the community’s desire to help make models better! We’ve added an opt-in to allow you to help find model jaggedness with your queries. We will still not train on your queries, but this does make it easier for us to find issues and help debug your use cases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们感谢社区希望帮助改进模型的热情！ 我们新增了一个可选加入的选项，让您可以通过自己的查询帮助发现模型表现不稳定之处。 我们仍然不会使用您的查询进行训练，但这确实能让我们更轻松地发现问题，并帮助调试您的使用场景。

sents.en: We love the community’s desire to help make models better!
sents.zh: 我们感谢社区希望帮助改进模型的热情！

sents.en: We’ve added an opt-in to allow you to help find model jaggedness with your queries.
sents.zh: 我们新增了一个可选加入的选项，让您可以通过自己的查询帮助发现模型表现不稳定之处。

sents.en: We will still not train on your queries, but this does make it easier for us to find issues and help debug your use cases.
sents.zh: 我们仍然不会使用您的查询进行训练，但这确实能让我们更轻松地发现问题，并帮助调试您的使用场景。

paragraphs.en: We’re also releasing a new version of Jev under jev-preview ! Not meant to be flashy but instead be small, subtle improvements to everything . Most things should be a tiny bit better, but we expect the largest gain in multi-lingual support.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还在 jev-preview 下发布了新版本的 Jev！ 它并不追求炫目，而是对各方面进行小而细致的改进。 大多数功能都应该有一点点提升，但我们预计最大的收益在多语言支持方面。

sents.en: We’re also releasing a new version of Jev under jev-preview !
sents.zh: 我们还在 jev-preview 下发布了新版本的 Jev！

sents.en: Not meant to be flashy but instead be small, subtle improvements to everything .
sents.zh: 它并不追求炫目，而是对各方面进行小而细致的改进。

sents.en: Most things should be a tiny bit better, but we expect the largest gain in multi-lingual support.
sents.zh: 大多数功能都应该有一点点提升，但我们预计最大的收益在多语言支持方面。

paragraphs.en: Model releases should generally also be strict improvements, but we’re well aware of how much developers hate updating their dependencies. jev-latest will be updated to jev-1.14.0 in a week. jev-1.13.0 will be available for a while.
paragraphs.zh: 模型发布通常也应严格地是改进，但我们非常清楚开发者有多么讨厌更新他们的依赖项。jev-latest 将在一周后更新为 jev-1.14.0。jev-1.13.0 将在一段时间内继续可用。

paragraphs.en: We intend to give 60 days warning before jev-1.13.0 is formally deprecated, and 30 days for jev-1.14.0 . We’ll release a deprecation policy prior to this.
paragraphs.zh: 我们打算在 jev-1.13.0 正式弃用前提前 60 天发出通知，jev-1.14.0 则提前 30 天。 我们将在此之前发布一份弃用政策。

sents.en: We intend to give 60 days warning before jev-1.13.0 is formally deprecated, and 30 days for jev-1.14.0 .
sents.zh: 我们打算在 jev-1.13.0 正式弃用前提前 60 天发出通知，jev-1.14.0 则提前 30 天。

sents.en: We’ll release a deprecation policy prior to this.
sents.zh: 我们将在此之前发布一份弃用政策。

paragraphs.en: As you all know, we dislike public benchmarks . However, we have our own internal best guesses on how to measure the form factor of intelligence that matters most for developers.
paragraphs.zh: 众所周知，我们不喜欢公开基准测试。 然而，对于如何衡量对开发者最重要的那种智能形态，我们有自己的内部最佳推测。

sents.en: As you all know, we dislike public benchmarks .
sents.zh: 众所周知，我们不喜欢公开基准测试。

sents.en: However, we have our own internal best guesses on how to measure the form factor of intelligence that matters most for developers.
sents.zh: 然而，对于如何衡量对开发者最重要的那种智能形态，我们有自己的内部最佳推测。

paragraphs.en: We’re trying something new out here: we’re going to treat you guys like adults and share this with you all.
paragraphs.zh: 我们正在尝试一些新的做法：我们将把你们当作成年人来对待，并与你们所有人分享这件事。

paragraphs.en: This measurement is our best guess and will continue to evolve. If ever we show you our internal numbers again, don’t expect them to be consistent.
paragraphs.zh: 这一衡量指标只是我们目前最好的估计，未来还会继续演变。 如果我们再次向你们展示内部数据，请不要指望它们保持一致。

sents.en: This measurement is our best guess and will continue to evolve.
sents.zh: 这一衡量指标只是我们目前最好的估计，未来还会继续演变。

sents.en: If ever we show you our internal numbers again, don’t expect them to be consistent.
sents.zh: 如果我们再次向你们展示内部数据，请不要指望它们保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Don’t believe it entirely. Always favor your own experimentation and evals with your use cases.
paragraphs.zh: 不要完全相信它。 始终优先针对你自己的使用场景进行实验和评估。

sents.en: Don’t believe it entirely.
sents.zh: 不要完全相信它。

sents.en: Always favor your own experimentation and evals with your use cases.
sents.zh: 始终优先针对你自己的使用场景进行实验和评估。

paragraphs.en: We’re including only open weight models because we guard our validation set very closely and are spooked out about the data policies of our model providers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们仅纳入开放权重模型，因为我们非常严格地保护我们的验证集，并且对模型提供商的数据政策感到不安。

paragraphs.en: This is likely biased towards our models. Feel free to ignore our model, and instead focus on the relative ranking of open source models.
paragraphs.zh: 这可能偏向我们的模型。 可以忽略我们的模型，而关注开源模型之间的相对排名。

sents.en: This is likely biased towards our models.
sents.zh: 这可能偏向我们的模型。

sents.en: Feel free to ignore our model, and instead focus on the relative ranking of open source models.
sents.zh: 可以忽略我们的模型，而关注开源模型之间的相对排名。

paragraphs.en: Lots of people love to ask what kind of sci-fi we’re releasing next. While we are working on some mindblowing stuff, expect most releases to be beautifully boring (like we think AI should be): small improvements across the board, better stability, and features for real deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 很多人喜欢问我们接下来要发布什么样的科幻级产品。 虽然我们正在做一些令人震撼的东西，但请预期大多数发布都是“美好的平淡”（我们认为 AI 就应该如此）：全方位的小幅改进、更好的稳定性，以及面向真实部署的功能。

sents.en: Lots of people love to ask what kind of sci-fi we’re releasing next.
sents.zh: 很多人喜欢问我们接下来要发布什么样的科幻级产品。

sents.en: While we are working on some mindblowing stuff, expect most releases to be beautifully boring (like we think AI should be): small improvements across the board, better stability, and features for real deployment.
sents.zh: 虽然我们正在做一些令人震撼的东西，但请预期大多数发布都是“美好的平淡”（我们认为 AI 就应该如此）：全方位的小幅改进、更好的稳定性，以及面向真实部署的功能。
